I will upgrade the severity of the background artifacts to 2.5 due to the classifier's confusion implying deeper structural issues.

This indicates the generated image lacks sufficient distinctive biological features for correct classification, or possesses features that confuse the model with rigid objects. It is not a clear 'thunder snake'.

The Classifier's confusion with 'locks' suggests the snake's texture/coiling may have unnatural, rigid, or metallic qualities (a subtle structural artifact).
